findings.entity: Background wall layout and hanging blue coat
findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:07, the man stands to the right of a plain blue coat, with an olive-green wall strip (featuring a mounted wooden box) separating the door behind him from the framed picture on the far right. As the man turns left at 00:07 and his body occludes the background, the right half of the door and the green wall strip with the wooden box vanish completely; by 00:08, the blue coat emerges behind his back with an added white stripe and is now positioned directly adjacent to the framed picture.
